body: The Inn at Houndslake was founded almost 40 years ago by developer Robert E. Penland, and it is still owned by the founding family today. Peggy Penland owns the Inn, and it is not unusual to be met and welcomed by her in person.

The décor is traditional, with the simplicity and feeling of a home away from home. The patio opens onto the golf course and endless walking paths, and with just 30 rooms each guest can enjoy the Inn's privacy or the social side of breakfast.

quote.text: Peggy and the service staff always greet us and make us feel like family.

items.title: Houndslake Country Club
items.text: An 18-hole championship course designed by Joe Lee. Each nine measures a little over 3,300 yards and plays to a par of 36.

items.title: Masters Week
items.text: A relaxed base 23 miles from Augusta National, with a nightly complimentary cocktail party, a hot Southern breakfast every morning and the tournament on the big screen in the Hospitality Room.

items.title: Seasonal getaways
items.text: We coordinate with local businesses and events, from golf to equestrian weekends, to make your visit seamless.
